name: Posterior contraction under Gaussian-process priors
model_likelihood: Fixed-design independent Gaussian regression; density estimation, binary regression and Gaussian white noise also treated
prior: Gaussian process on regression function or drift; normalized exponential GP for density
estimand: Posterior contraction rate around the fixed true parameter in model-appropriate global metrics
data_input: Individual observations Y_i with fixed known x_i for regression; IID observations or binary-response pairs and white-noise paths in other settings
tunable_settings: Covariance kernel and prior smoothness; scale factors a and b in integrated Brownian examples; finite-series truncation and coefficient scales
